Class Icon

java.lang.Object
stockly.ui.Icon
public final class Icon extends Object
Lightweight vector icon set drawn with Graphics2D.

Each icon is rendered as strokes/fills at draw time, so icons stay crisp at any size and can be tinted per state — no image assets or emoji required. Call draw(Graphics2D, String, int, int, int, Color) with one of the supported names.

Author:
Tooba Akram & Abeeha Noor

    • draw

      public static void draw(Graphics2D g, String name, int x, int y, int size, Color color)
      Draws the named icon centered in a size×size box.
      Parameters:
      g - graphics context
      name - one of the * name constants
      x - left of the icon box
      y - top of the icon box
      size - icon box edge length
      color - stroke/fill color
